tool.name: render_map
tool.description: Render one exact GeoJSON or GeoTIFF/COG INPUT or named RESULT Data version as a single static PNG in its source CRS, plus a summary of source extent, image dimensions, style and nodata. A nonempty valueField colors a numeric GeoJSON property; leave it empty for rasters or uniform vector styling. No reprojection, basemap, multi-layer composition, interactivity or PDF is provided.

semantics.description: Single-source static PNG rendered at the requested dimensions with title, source CRS coordinate axes and extent annotation. A selected numeric GeoJSON field or raster band 1 is colored with the requested palette and explicit unit; nodata is shown separately.
semantics.crs: The source CRS is preserved without reprojection and printed on the map axes.
limitations: The PNG contains one source only and does not provide a basemap, multiple layers, interactivity, tiles, a publication service, or PDF output.
Colors and labels visualize existing data but do not establish its accuracy, provenance, unit, analytical validity, or vertical datum.

semantics.description: One render summary recording source kind and format, source CRS and extent, output width and height, title, value field, palette, explicit unit, colorbar label, nodata styling and vector-feature or rendered-pixel nodata counts.
semantics.grain: one summary per static PNG render
semantics.crs: The crs and extent fields use the unchanged source coordinate reference system.
limitations: No reprojection is performed; extent coordinates remain in the source CRS.
Raster valid and nodata counts describe rendered pixels after bounded nearest-neighbour display resampling, not necessarily every source pixel.
The renderer has no basemap, multi-layer composition, interactivity, tile publication, or PDF output.
